title.narrative: Innovation Program for Social Inclusion and Productivity
Programa de Innovacin para la Inclusin Social y la Productividad

description.narrative: El objetivo general del programa es contribuir a mejorar la inclusin social y la productividad, a travs del fomento de la inversin en innovacin e investigacin. Los objetivos especficos son: (i) aumentar las capacidades de planificacin, ejecucin, articulacin y evaluacin del Sistema Nacional de Innovacin; (ii) incrementar las capacidades de innovacin e investigacin del sector productivo en las reas prioritarias del Plan Estratgico de Ciencia, Tecnologa e Innovacin; (iii) promover innovacin social incrementando la participacin de grupos excluidos en el proceso de innovacin; y (iv) incrementar las capacidades de innovacin e investigacin en el sector social.

The program's general objective is to contribute to improved social inclusion and productivity by promoting investment in innovation and research. The specific objectives are to: (i) build the planning, execution, coordination, and evaluation capacity of the National Innovation System (SNI); (ii) build the innovation and research capacity of the productive sector in the priority areas of the Strategic Plan for Science, Technology, and Innovation (PENCYT); (iii) promote social innovation through greater involvement of excluded groups in the innovation process; and (iv) build innovation and research capacity in the social sector.
